Name: Better Wizard for Seasonal Outfits
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
[size=3]THIS IS NOT A MOD, THIS IS JUST THE IMAGE FILES. You will need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod and then replace the images![/size]

I thought our dear wizard deserved an improvement (and I also wanted his hair to remain purple in all seasons) so I made small changes to his haircut, face and added some accessories to his hat and outfit.

[code]﻿[/code]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b]:
[/size]
[list]
[*]Download mod manually and unzip
[*]Open the "wizard" folder
[*]You will find two folders: "character" and "portrait"
[*]Copy the images and paste them into the "wizard" folder of Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, overwrite all changes (put the portrait images  in the "wizard" folder located in the "portraits" folder from the mod, and the character images in the "wizard" folder located in the "characters" folder from the mod)
[*]Run game as normal
[/list]

I hope you like it! Also, feel free to comment if you have any feedback or something doesn't work. Thank you!
[code]﻿
